assessments.reasoning: LaTeX Project governing r1 event 4722522a7b40459fba003a5a429e98f9 matches the 1.1 capture and [2199,9100). The opening sentences and subsequent eight modified-file conditions distinguish the two cases.

challenge.method: Tested distribution of one unchanged file from a two-file Program and distribution of a modified file with sufficient information under condition 8(B).
challenge.results: The first case fails completeness. The second is a separate conditional route. Condition 8(A) also allows equivalent access from the same place without compelling recipients to download the Program.

limitations: The conclusion concerns the unmodified Program. File-specific provisions can affect modified files.
reasoning: The 1.1 conditions open by permitting distribution of a complete, unmodified Program and expressly disallowing distribution of only part under that provision.
